text: mingalarpar shin
normalized_burmese: မင်္ဂလာပါရှင်
english_meaning: Hello.

text: a ko shi lr
normalized_burmese: အကို ရှိလား
english_meaning: Bro, are you there?

text: dee shirt lay XL shi thay lr
normalized_burmese: ဒီရှပ်အင်္ကျီလေး XL ဆိုဒ် ရှိသေးလား
english_meaning: Is this shirt still available in XL?

text: ae dr bl lout lel
normalized_burmese: အဲ့ဒါ ဘယ်လောက်လဲ
english_meaning: How much is that?

text: order tin mal nw black M size 2 khu
normalized_burmese: အော်ဒါတင်မယ်နော်၊ အနက်ရောင် M ဆိုဒ် ၂ ခု
english_meaning: I'll place an order, 2 pieces in black, size M.

text: ygn twin deli kha lb lout lel, mdy ko kaw poh loh ya lr
normalized_burmese: ရန်ကုန်မြို့တွင်း ပို့ခ ဘယ်လောက်ကျလဲ၊ မန္တလေးကိုကော ပို့လို့ရလား
english_meaning: How much is delivery within Yangon? Can you also deliver to Mandalay?

text: kpay nk pay ya mhar lr? cod m ya buu lr
normalized_burmese: KPay နဲ့ ပေးရမှာလား၊ COD မရဘူးလား
english_meaning: Do I have to pay with KPay? Is cash on delivery not available?

text: sis order cancel chin loh, ma yuu tot buu
normalized_burmese: အစ်မ အော်ဒါ cancel လုပ်ချင်လို့၊ မယူတော့ဘူး
english_meaning: Sis, I want to cancel my order, I don't want it anymore.

text: ma nay ka ya tae item ka size lone wa ma hman buu sis chart atine pl yuu tr ahku L ka M lout pl shi tl. phone khaw tr lae ma kine bu. pyan lal pay loh ya lar 😤
normalized_burmese: မနေ့က ရတဲ့ပစ္စည်းက ဆိုဒ်လုံးဝမမှန်ဘူး အစ်မ၊ chart အတိုင်းပဲယူတာ၊ အခု L က M လောက်ပဲရှိတယ်။ ဖုန်းခေါ်တာလည်း မကိုင်ဘူး။ ပြန်လဲပေးလို့ရလား
english_meaning: The item I got yesterday is completely the wrong size, sis. I ordered by the size chart, but this L is only as big as an M. Nobody picks up when I call either. Can I exchange it?

text: 2 khu yuu yin discount ma pay buu lr
english_meaning: Don't you give a discount if I buy two?

text: 11.11 promo pee thwr pyi lr ahku wal yin 11.11 zay nk ya thay lr
english_meaning: Is the 11.11 promo over? If I buy now, can I still get the 11.11 price?

text: hii admin 👋
normalized_burmese: ဟိုင်း admin
english_meaning: Hi admin.
(Laughing emojis, no clear meaning.)

text: ok
normalized_burmese: အိုကေ
english_meaning: OK.

text: live bl ah chain lwint mhr lal
normalized_burmese: Live ဘယ်အချိန် လွှင့်မှာလဲ
english_meaning: What time will you go live?

text: ya ya chin pl pyat nay tal, pike san pyn pay loh ya lrr
normalized_burmese: ရရချင်းပဲ ပျက်နေတယ်၊ ပိုက်ဆံ ပြန်ပေးလို့ရလား
english_meaning: It was broken as soon as I got it. Can I get my money back?

text: d serum ka oily skin atwet a sin pyay lr
normalized_burmese: ဒီ serum က အဆီပြန်တဲ့ အသားအရေအတွက် အဆင်ပြေလား
english_meaning: Is this serum okay for oily skin?

text: parcel ka 1 pat kyar pyi naw ma ya thay buu, bl yout nay lal check pay pr
normalized_burmese: ပါဆယ်က တစ်ပတ်ကြာပြီနော် မရသေးဘူး၊ ဘယ်ရောက်နေလဲ စစ်ပေးပါ
english_meaning: It's been a week and I still haven't received the parcel. Please check where it is.

text: price nk stock pyaw pay pr cod ya lr
normalized_burmese: ဈေးနဲ့ stock ရှိမရှိ ပြောပေးပါ၊ COD ရလား
english_meaning: Please tell me the price and whether it's in stock. Is COD available?

text: ma yuu tok buu naw
english_meaning: I won't take it anymore.

text: ngwe lwal pyii pyi nw ss poh htr tl check pay pr
normalized_burmese: ငွေလွှဲပြီးပြီနော်၊ screenshot ပို့ထားတယ်၊ စစ်ပေးပါ
english_meaning: I've already transferred the money and sent the screenshot. Please check.

text: original lr? a tu ma hote buu moh lr
normalized_burmese: original လား၊ အတုမဟုတ်ဘူး မလား
english_meaning: Is it original? It's not fake, right?

text: blue ko change chin tl, black ka photo nk ma tuu buu
normalized_burmese: အပြာရောင်နဲ့ ပြောင်းချင်တယ်၊ အနက်ရောင်က ဓာတ်ပုံနဲ့ မတူဘူး
english_meaning: I want to change it to blue. The black one doesn't look like the photo.

text: admin reply pyn par om 3 yet shi pyi msg poh tar customer ko de lo lote lr 🙄
normalized_burmese: admin ပြန်စာပြန်ပါဦး၊ မက်ဆေ့ပို့တာ ၃ ရက်ရှိပြီ၊ customer ကို ဒီလိုလုပ်လား
english_meaning: Admin, please reply. It's been 3 days since I messaged. Is this how you treat customers?

text: dr lay ka b lout lel, ma soe yin 2 khu yu mal, deli free lr
normalized_burmese: ဒါလေးက ဘယ်လောက်လဲ၊ မဆိုးရင် ၂ ခုယူမယ်၊ ပို့ခ free လား
english_meaning: How much is this one? If it's not bad, I'll take two. Is delivery free?
